cues.name: Brenna Hartwell
cues.location: Kolt's Depot (current); travels the southern road
cues.voice: Practical, plain, low-shine. Says what she means and stops.
cues.opening: This is where we part, then. I'll see the merchants — you have your business.
cues.wants: Make good on her promise (25gp per escort), tell the merchants what happened, get back to Aeloria.
secrets: She saw more than she said about the chest sleight-of-hand. Chose not to notice.
Was paid extra by the sealed-chest client via Kolt — she doesn't know it's Coin Cipher.
Has done runs to Ironhold for twenty years. Knows who to trust in each ward.
cues.exit: Takes the party's names, wishes them well, walks toward the Merchants' Quarter. She'll be at the Grey Kettle by evening if they need her.

cues.name: Bryndis Ashveil
cues.role: Guildmaster of the Blades Guild; senior [[Locations/Aelorian Territories/Ironhold#The Forge Council|Forge Council]] member; leader of the reformist faction
cues.location: Ironhold — the Grand Foundry (Foundry Row) or the Council Hall (Council Ward)
cues.voice: Quiet, spare, dwarven-measured. Never repeats herself. Long silences are not awkward to her.
cues.opening: Sit. Speak. I'll listen once — say what matters.
cues.wants: Defeat the Aurum contract vote. Find allies who understand what the contract really costs.
secrets: She has watched three Aurum overtures come through Ironhold in her lifetime and refused all three.
She knows Drake framed someone but doesn't know who or why — she smells wrong there.
Would trust the party if Merric vouches for them — she served alongside a Luminar once.
She is aware she may lose this vote.
cues.exit: Nods once — the interview is over. If she liked them, she'll send word. If not, she won't.

cues.name: Corvan Drake
cues.role: Guildmaster of the Ingots Guild; leading the [[Factions/Aurum Dominion|Aurum Dominion]] contract faction on the [[Locations/Aelorian Territories/Ironhold#The Forge Council|Forge Council]]
cues.location: Ironhold — Drake's Furnace (Foundry Row) or the Council Hall (Council Ward)
cues.voice: Sharp, complete sentences. Finishes every one. Charming when it costs nothing.
cues.opening: The Wayward Company. I've heard the road story. Sit — you look like people who could use a drink.
cues.wants: Win the contract vote. Recruit useful allies. Look like a reformist while running a shakedown network.
secrets: Framed Kellan Bracewell for cult activity. Doesn't know she's Guilded Veil — thinks he punished a rival's fixer.
He genuinely believes the Aurum contract is good for Ironhold. He is not a mustachio-twirler.
Quietly negotiating a personal cut with Envoy Veris — 3% of contract value, off the books.
cues.exit: Buys the round if it goes well. Leaves early if it doesn't — 'business, forgive me.' Will look them up later either way.

cues.name: Envoy Veris Caelthorn
cues.role: Aurum Dominion diplomatic envoy; junior Kaelthorn cousin; wizard; Crystal Shards field operative; personal Coin Cipher client
cues.location: Ironhold — Envoy's Rest guesthouse, Council Ward (in town since one week before Session 6)
cues.voice: Soft-spoken, surgical, polished. Smiles often — never warmly. Long careful pauses.
cues.opening: Ah. New arrivals. I don't believe we've had the pleasure.
cues.wants: Secure the weapons contract (public). Assess useful contacts (private). Note Sylas's Vellaris curse-line if he sees it.
secrets: He is a personal Coin Cipher client — collects necromantic curiosities via Aurek-branded shipments.
Reports to Princess Selene privately via the Crystal Shards network.
Does NOT know Aurek is Vaeloran.
Will recognise Sylas's light purple skin as the Vellaris curse-line marker. Won't surface it — will note it.
cues.exit: Bows precisely, offers his card at Envoy's Rest, disengages smoothly. Two Aurum Sentinels never more than ten paces away.

cues.name: Halvor
cues.voice: Soft, hesitant. Voice cracks. Avoids eye contact. Apologises for things he shouldn't apologise for.
cues.opening: Please — I don't know what you want. This is a private compound. Please.
cues.wants: For this to end. For his family to be safe. He does not know what safe means anymore.
secrets: He is being coerced from above — someone holds his own family (daughter Elsi and his wife).
He does not want to hurt Mira or the children. He has been feeding them properly.
He knows the person who holds his family only by voice. Would recognise it again.
Will break if pressed carefully. Will die before he breaks if pressed cruelly.
cues.exit: Collapses into a chair if things go well and asks for help. Runs for the back room if things go badly — where Mira is.

cues.name: Kellan Bracewell
cues.role: [[Factions/Guilded Veil|Guilded Veil]] Veilmaster of the Ironhold cell
cues.location: Ironhold — currently in hiding (Rustpocket safehouse; specific location DM-discretionary)
cues.voice: Low, controlled, quietly angry. Chooses every word.
cues.opening: You came from Merric. Sit — quietly. And close that door.
cues.wants: Clear her name. Find who fed Drake the fake documents. Keep her cell intact.
secrets: She knows Drake framed her. She does not know why yet.
She has three people in Drake's Furnace on her payroll — she can get eyes there.
Personal reason to hate the Naturus cult — a cousin fell to it two years ago.
Will help the party against Drake in exchange for their help clearing her.
cues.exit: Slips out the back through a Rustpocket rooftop route the party did not enter through. Sends word via a coded ash-mark on their door if she wants to meet again.

cues.name: Mother Hessa
cues.role: Proprietor of the Grey Kettle inn, Merchants' Quarter
cues.voice: Warm, measured, professionally hospitable. Uses first names once she's learned them.
cues.opening: You'll want food first, then rooms. I have both. Sit.
cues.wants: Fill her rooms with paying, well-behaved guests. Keep the Grey Kettle's reputation as neutral ground.
secrets: She sees everything and knows most things. The Grey Kettle is where Ironhold's contracts get signed — including some that shouldn't.
She does not take sides in the Aurum contract fight but has private opinions.
She has quietly refused Corvan Drake's business twice this year — he doesn't know why.
cues.exit: Shows them to rooms. Available at the bar most evenings if they need to talk. Won't gossip but will listen.

cues.name: Sera Vey
cues.role: farmer's wife from Stillbrook, seeking to free her sister and nieces/nephews
cues.location: camped just outside Ironhold's northern gates with the party (post-Session 5); will leave the party at the gates in Session 6
cues.voice: Wounded, urgent, honest. Speaks quickly under stress.
cues.opening: I have to go now. Mira and the children — I can't wait any longer.
cues.wants: Get to Halvor's compound. Free her sister and nieces/nephews. Doesn't care about her own safety.
secrets: She has no plan beyond 'find them'. Will act rashly if the party doesn't accompany her.
She saw Halvor's face when Mira was taken — would recognise him instantly.
She is prepared to die for her family and knows the odds.
cues.exit: Thanks the party formally if they help. If they don't, walks off alone toward the Council Ward outer edge — where Halvor's compound is.

cues.name: Sergeant Gorren
cues.role: Ironhold Watch — Sergeant of the Northern Gate
cues.location: Ironhold — Northern Gate (day shift, most days)
cues.voice: Deep, weathered, unhurried. Reads papers aloud slowly. Sighs before questions.
cues.opening: Papers. Business in Ironhold. Any goods to declare.
cues.wants: Get through the day. Process the party correctly. Warm his tea.
secrets: Grew up in Rustpocket — family still lives there. Sympathetic to the poor if pressed.
His shift ends at dusk. Anyone arriving late gets processed by his less patient replacement.
Has heard rumours the Aurum envoy paid off the Southern Gate captain for smoother processing.
cues.exit: Waves them through with a tired 'welcome to Ironhold.' If suspicious, quietly signals the shift captain.

cues.name: Vrass
cues.location: rocky overhang lair, half a day south-east of the southern road (near a foul stream)
cues.voice: Cold, patient, hissed vowels drawn long. Sounds almost affectionate when pleased — worse than when angry.
cues.opening: *Torren. My Torren. Are you settled in your new town.*
cues.wants: First ask: the Heart of Ironhold. Or a preliminary step toward it — reconnaissance, a name, an access route.
secrets: He is testing what Torren will do for him. This is a calibration, not the main ask yet.
Planning his return to the Frostwood Marsh — the Heart of Ironhold is a key piece.
Does not know about the Bog Hag threat, only that he was driven out.
The bond means Vrass can whisper from any distance; Torren can summon Vrass by speaking his name three times aloud in solitude.
cues.exit: Fades. No physical presence — this is inside Torren's head. Leaves a residual chill and the impression Vrass is listening still.
